units.source_text: 也许是自己多心，男人察觉到被嘲弄的意味，

en.t: Perhaps he was being oversensitive, but the man sensed a hint of mockery,

units.source_text: 忽地他想起女人说的一番话，想起那个同他遭受一样遭遇的兜售风景明信片的人，而且还病死了。

en.t: and suddenly he remembered something the woman had said; he remembered the man who sold scenic postcards, who had suffered the same fate as he had and had even died of illness.
